messages:
Maya (docs): FYI I opened a PR to update the rate-limit and quota examples to the latest metering + tiering schema. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/docs/pull/5401. Looking for quick checks on the HTTP JSON, SDK snippet, and dashboard pointer.
Ibrahim (eng): Nice. Do NOT use the old X-Usage-Plan header in examples anymore. Docs should prefer the JSON metering payload and include a short migration note about X-Redwood-Usage as a backwards-compatible header.
Maya (docs): Will update. I currently have a tiny HTTP example and a 2-line JS SDK snippet that calls metering.record().
Renee (product): Also update the sample tier math: marketing changed Standard band to 75k-600k and Pro to >600k. Add a parenthetical: (refer to pricing page for live bands).
Toby (devex): SDK example should match v3 semantics: metering.record({ customerId, items: [...] }). Keep the snippet copy-paste friendly.
Maya (docs): Adjusted SDK to metering.record({ customerId: "acct_456", items: [{ "generation.tokens": 90000 }] }). And switched HTTP block to JSON body.
Ibrahim (eng): Payload looks good. One minor nit: remove the trailing comma after acct_456 and use ISO timestamp.
Maya (docs): Fixed both. Also swapped Grafana link to the new panel: https://grafana.redwood/d/usage/overview?panelId=15 and added alt text: "Daily metered tokens by tier".
build-bot: Preview build for PR 5401 created: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/5401 (build 834).
Renee (product): Approved from Product. Quick edit: in the migration note add a sentence: "Unit calculations (tokens -> tier) are unaffected by the header migration."
Maya (docs): Added migration sentence and a tiny diff snippet showing old vs new. Planning to merge in 20m unless issues. Thanks! :shipit:
